Celebrities and athletes attend Wimbledon, with Indian stars drawing attention

Wimbledon's galleries have been graced by a mix of international celebrities and prominent Indian athletes, including cricketers Shubman Gill and Sachin Tendulkar, and Bollywood personalities. The presence of these figures, particularly in the Royal Box, has generated significant social media buzz and media coverage, highlighting the global appeal of the tournament and its intersection with Indian sports and entertainment.
